newsitem.title: USA: Loewen in acquisitions worth over $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Loewen in acquisitions worth over $50 mln.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said Sunday it has signed acquisition agreements totaling more than US$50 million in conjunction with the annual National Funeral Directors Association (NFDA) conference held recently in Cincinnati, Ohio.
The total value of acquisitions Loewen has signed or closed since the launch of Service Corp International's takeover bid on October 2 is about US$150 million.

Acquisitions either signed or closed year-to-date by Loewen totals about US$760 million, excluding Loewen's investments with The Blackstone Group to acquire Prime Succession Inc and Rose Hills Memorial Park Association, for US$295 million and US$240 million, respectively.
"We are the preferred acquirer in our industry in North America," said Raymond Loewen, chairman, in a statement accompanying the announcement.

"Our management culture and values are key to our acquisition momentum. Our primary corporate focus remains clear: to actively pursue the acquisition of properties that will allow us to enhance our long-term shareholder value," he said.
